title: Gimbal object wobbles after video cuts out

tellings.quote: according to the air crew, it wobbles after the video cuts out, right?

plain: The object in the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy clip of an unknown object filmed off Florida, wobbles after the footage ends, according to the aircrew who saw it. Marik von Rennenkampff, who takes the side of the believers in a debate with the skeptic Mick West on the show, says this, citing Ryan Graves, a Navy pilot who has spoken publicly about such sightings. The point is that the crew saw the object move on its own, which would be hard to explain as a trick of the camera.
